<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>State of Martinia</title>
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 100 100'%3E%3Cpolygon fill='%23B4401F' points='50,4 61,38 97,38 68,59 79,94 50,73 21,94 32,59 3,38 39,38'/%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rozha+One&family=Libre+Franklin:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --field: #F4E1C1;   /* flag cream, sampled */
    --stripe: #B4401F;  /* flag red, sampled */
    --ink: #3A2716;     /* lettering brown */
    --cream-ink: #FBF1DE;
    --grass: #7E8450;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; }
  html, body { height: 100%; }
  body {
    background: var(--field);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: "Libre Franklin", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  /* The field: star, cats, and the lettering where "California Republic" would sit */
  .field {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 4vh 5vw 3vh;
    gap: 1.5vh;
  }
  .star {
    position: absolute;
    top: 6vh;
    left: 5.5vw;
    width: clamp(48px, 9vw, 150px);
    height: auto;
  }
  .cats {
    width: min(82vw, 115vh);
    max-height: 58vh;
    object-fit: contain;
    -webkit-mask-image:
      linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 4%, #000 96%, transparent),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 3%, #000 97%, transparent);
    -webkit-mask-composite: source-in;
    mask-image:
      linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 4%, #000 96%, transparent),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, #000 3%, #000 97%, transparent);
    mask-composite: intersect;
  }
  h1 {
    font-family: "Rozha One", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 7vw, 6.5rem);
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }

  /* The red stripe doubles as navigation */
  .stripe {
    background: var(--stripe);
    color: var(--cream-ink);
    min-height: 15vh;
    padding: 2.2vh 5.5vw;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 1.25rem 3rem;
  }
  nav ul {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.4rem 2.2rem;
  }
  nav a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 0.3rem 0;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  }
  nav a:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--cream-ink); }
  nav a:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--cream-ink);
    outline-offset: 4px;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }
  .when {
    text-align: right;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .when .time { font-family: "Rozha One", Georgia, serif; font-size: 2rem; }
  .when .date { font-size: 0.95rem; opacity: 0.85; }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .stripe { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
    .when { text-align: left; }
    nav ul { gap: 0.6rem 1.6rem; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <main class="field">
    <svg class="star" viewBox="0 0 100 95" aria-hidden="true">
      <polygon fill="#B4401F" points="50,0 61,34 97,34 68,55 79,90 50,69 21,90 32,55 3,34 39,34"/>
    </svg>
    <img class="cats" alt="Two tabby cats on a patch of grass" src="data:image/webp;base64,">
    <h1>Hello, Martin</h1>
  </main>

  <footer class="stripe">
    <!-- Edit links here -->
    <nav aria-label="Bookmarks">
      <ul>
        <li><a href="https://dallastx-prod-av.accela.com/portlets/web/en-us/#/core/tasks">Accela</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://www.dallasnews.com/">DMN</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://www.nytimes.com/">NYT</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://www.dmagazine.com/">D Mag</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://www.dallasobserver.com/">Dallas Observer</a></li>
        <li><a href="https://cityofdallas.legistar.com/Calendar.aspx">Legistar</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
    <div class="when" aria-live="off">
      <div class="time" id="time"></div>
      <div class="date" id="date"></div>
    </div>
  </footer>

<script>
  const t = document.getElementById("time"), d = document.getElementById("date");
  function tick() {
    const now = new Date();
    t.textContent = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
    d.textContent = now.toLocaleDateString([], { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
  }
  tick();
  setInterval(tick, 1000);
</script>
</body>
</html>
